overview.title: The historic heart of Safi
overview.p1: Safi's medina brings together souks, mosques and traditional houses. Less touristy than Fez or Marrakech, it keeps an intense local life.
overview.p2: You will find commercial streets, squares and access to the sea castle and port.
overview.p3: Respect residents and combine with the potters' quarter or the ceramics museum.
